note: City of Quasqueton campground on a point on the Wapsipinicon River just above the Quasqueton dam, with boat ramps and a canoe/kayak launch. Some sites are let by the month. The city has campers evacuate when the Independence gauge reaches 11.5 ft. Water, restrooms and the shower house are shut off from October 15. --Claude
summary: City page and Park With Us booking site: 39 sites, 20/30/50 A + water, shower house, vault restroom, dump across the river, RV $25 / monthly $500, book online or via the camp host, 14-day limit. Season stated two ways (Mar 1-Dec 1 vs Apr 15-Oct 15), left unset. Not waterfront kept, with a lead up to riverview.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (up): not waterfront -> riverview proposed, re-audited because the city calls it 'a picturesque, riverfront, shaded campground'. The site map (parkwith.us) puts every numbered site inside the campground's own loop drives, with the loop road between the sites and the Wapsipinicon, so riverfront is blocked by the rule (own loop road = view at best). On NAIP (summer, 0.17 m/px) the south loop (sites 23-39) has open mowed grass with a few large trees for ~25-35 m between the riverside lane and the bank, and the river is the ~75-100 m wide pool above the dam, so a view across the lane is supported there; the north loop (1A-22) has a wooded band along the bank. Map sites 38/39 may sit east of the lane on the open grass (unclear on the schematic); if so they would need a fresh look for riverfront.

SEASON: two operator pages disagree. City page: 'Our campground season runs March 1st through December 1st' / 'Camping is allowed beginning March 1st, weather and conditions permitting, to December 1st.' Park With Us booking page: 'Our campground season runs April 15th through October 15th', 'CAMPGROUND RESERVATIONS ENDS NOVEMBER 6TH, 2026', water shut off October 15. Season left unset.

LONG-STAY: monthly sites are sold ($500/month, 2025 monthly request form). Of the ~50 site records on Park With Us, 24 are online-bookable nightly (1A-4A, 7A-11A, 12-24, 26, 30); the B sites and most of 25-39 are not bookable online, and imagery shows trailers with sheds and decks in the south loop. City-run, so the private gate does not apply, but the nightly share is about half.
FIT: online-bookable sites list max lengths 20-50 ft; 1A and 14 are 20 ft, the rest 30-50 ft, so a 23-ft rig fits most.
PIN: stored 42.39515,-91.76350 is in the north loop; the campground runs ~42.3935-42.3965 on the point. OK (<250 m).
PHONE 319-448-0053 (camp host, city page). OK. WEBSITE https://quasky.com/campground OK; booking link https://parkwith.us/camps/veterans-memorial-park-and-campground.
RATE DATE: the $25 is on the live city page beside 2025-dated forms; no 2026 rate sheet seen (Park With Us prices load only in the app).
